name: GPACKET
recent: Green Packet 正在以分期付款方式支付收购 A Tech Insure 75% 股权的余款，并已存入第二笔款项。公司同时在进行最多约 30% 股本的私募配售。最新季度营收环比增长 43.9%，但同比下滑 53.6%，净亏损 980.5 万令吉。
notable: 公司与卖方签订变更协议，将 RM5,988,000 余款分五期支付，每期 RM1,197,600，从 2026 年 11 月 30 日起每月 30 日前支付。
公司已于 2026 年 10 月 29 日向卖方律师支付 RM2,994,000 作为第二笔款项。
公司正在进行最多 598,476,400 股新股的私募配售，约占已发行股份的 30%。
risks: 私募配售最多约 30% 新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
若未能按期支付任何一期余款，全数余额将立即到期，卖方有权采取法律行动追讨。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 3391.9 万令吉，环比增长 43.9%，同比下滑 53.6%；净亏损 980.5 万令吉，净亏损率 28.9%，上一季度为 22.4%。

recent_en: Green Packet is paying the balance for its 75% stake acquisition in A Tech Insure in instalments and has deposited the second payment. The company is also undertaking a private placement of up to about 30% of its share base. Latest quarter revenue rose 43.9% QoQ but fell 53.6% YoY, with a net loss of MYR 9.805 million.
notable_en: The company signed a variation agreement with vendors to pay the RM5,988,000 balance in five monthly instalments of RM1,197,600 each, starting 30 November 2026.
The company released RM2,994,000 to the vendors' solicitors as the second payment on 29 October 2026.
The company is undertaking a private placement of up to 598,476,400 new shares, about 30% of its issued shares.
risks_en: The private placement of up to about 30% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
If any instalment of the balance is not paid on time, the full amount becomes immediately due and the vendors may commence legal action.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 33.919 million, up 43.9% QoQ but down 53.6% YoY; net loss was MYR 9.805 million with a net margin of -28.9%, versus -22.4% in the prior quarter.
